summary: Lemhi County, Idaho lookout on a ridge north of Napoleon Hill: two-story log cabin dated 1935, emergency status 1950, gone by 1966; no description of the site today.

facts.status_note: Both lookout pages list it as gone by 1966; no source describes the site now

staffing.status: Walter Waetzig named as heading to the lookout in 1936; no later staffing in the sources read

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts dates the first lookout to 1932 (Murdock McNicoll); firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts date a two-story log cabin to 1935. The story reports both and says the pages do not settle whether they are the same building.

notes_for_editor: Name: sources spell it 'Napolean' (firelookout.com, Forest Lookouts) and 'Napoleon' (Idaho Fire Lookouts, climbing guide). The story uses 'Napoleon Hill'; the record's id and name are unchanged. Coordinates disagree: our record (45.34548, -114.00417) and a second set (45.37595, -114.00473) are about 3.4 km apart north to south. The climbing guide's parking point at the base of the south ridge is about 45.3425, -114.0033, close to our record. 'Two miles north of the summit' fits the second set better, so the editor should check which point is the lookout before any map use. Access and today's remains are not described by any source read; the climbing guide covers the summit route only. Staffing is limited to one 1936 name.
